seo_title: Cost of Living in Hurghada 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Hurghada per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: A resort on the Red Sea: a visa on arrival, a warm sea and sunshine almost year-round, and a large Russian-speaking community. Cheaper than Europe, but the summers are very hot and the urban setting is resort-simple.
pros: Visa on arrival, direct flights from Russia
A warm Red Sea and sunshine almost year-round
A large Russian-speaking community and services
Low prices for housing and food
cons: Poor tap water quality — you need bottled water

visa_steps.title: Visa on arrival
visa_steps.description: Russian citizens are issued a visa on arrival (a 30-day tourist visa) that can be extended.

visa_steps.title: Renting a home
visa_steps.description: Apartments and studios are rented by the month, especially cheaply off-season.

visa_steps.title: Connectivity and money
visa_steps.description: A local SIM card is inexpensive; you'll need pounds in cash and a card from a foreign bank.

visa_steps.title: Extension
visa_steps.description: A tourist visa is extended at the passport office in Hurghada.

visa_steps.title: Long-term stay
visa_steps.description: For settled living, people consider a residence permit through property or work.

faq.question: Do Russian citizens need a visa for Hurghada?
faq.answer: A visa is issued on arrival for 30 days, with the option to extend.

faq.question: How much does it cost to live in Hurghada?
faq.answer: It's cheap, especially housing and food off-season. The exact budget is in the calculator above.

faq.question: Which language is spoken in Hurghada?
faq.answer: Arabic; English and Russian are widely used in tourism.

faq.question: Can I pay with a Russian card in Hurghada?
faq.answer: No, Russian cards don't work. You'll need pounds in cash and a card from a foreign bank.

faq.question: What is the climate like in Hurghada?
faq.answer: Desert by the sea: hot summers, warm winters and almost year-round sunshine.

faq.question: Can you spend the winter there?
faq.answer: Yes, Hurghada is one of the popular winter destinations for Russians thanks to the warmth and prices.

reviews.text: Hurghada is sea, sun and affordable living, with plenty of Russian speakers. The downsides are the scorching summer and a resort-simple town, but it's great for working by the sea.
I winter here every year: warm, cheap, a direct flight. The infrastructure is resort-grade and you'd better not test serious healthcare, but the sea is beautiful.
